caption: Chatrie v. United States

caption: United States v. Smith

caption: United States v. House
proposition: Long-term warrantless pole-camera surveillance of a home that captures only what an ordinary passerby could see is not a Fourth Amendment search, reaffirming the circuit's Tuggle rule against a mosaic/Carpenter-style challenge.

caption: United States v. Holcomb
proposition: A digital-device search warrant containing an unrestricted dominion-and-control catch-all clause was overbroad and lacked particularity, rendering it an unconstitutional general warrant, with no good-faith or plain-view rescue and the evidence suppressed.

caption: Barnes v. Felix

caption: Chiaverini v. City of Napoleon

caption: Gonzalez v. Trevino

caption: Culley v. Marshall

caption: Case v. Montana

caption: United States v. Lowers
